title: Monter au Beurre
description: Finishing a sauce or soup by whisking in cold butter, off the heat — the restaurant gloss move.

steps.text: Have the butter COLD and cut into small cubes before you need it. Cold is not optional.
steps.why: Cold butter melts slowly enough for its water and fat to emulsify into the liquid. Soft butter just melts into a grease slick.

steps.text: Pull the pot off the heat. Whisk in one cube at a time, letting each disappear before the next.
steps.why: Off-heat, the temperature falls through the emulsion sweet spot. Rushing the cubes overwhelms the emulsion and it breaks.

steps.text: Serve immediately — a monté sauce does not hold or reheat.
steps.why: Reheating melts the emulsion apart; the gloss and body are gone and no amount of whisking brings them back.
